snippet.title: Nocturnals: Cacti Coast Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The first trailer for the Nocturnals sequel is finally here!

Wishlist Nocturnals: Cacti Coast on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3760140/Nocturnals_Cacti_Coast#game_area_purchase

🌵 Explore our new website for more details:
https://www.cowboytoad.games

📺 Subscribe to Cowboy Toad Games on YouTube where we'll be posting future trailers & content:
https://www.youtube.com/@cowboytoadgames

Join our official Discord server:
https://discord.gg/akemuca3WA

----

Return to the world of Nocturnals, where civilisation struggles to recover decades after creatures from outer-space laid it to ruin. Play as Ted, a hopeful survivor chasing rumours of a forgotten community deep within the foggy state of Cacti Coast. Along the way, you'll make friends and foes, all with differing views on what Cacti Coast has become - and what it should be. Your choices will shape not only Ted’s beliefs, but also the companions who join him and the places he dares to go. 

Coming late 2026!
